CommunityMember.title: CommunityMember
CommunityMember.description: Public community wall registration entry containing only the public nickname, verification flag, and server timestamp (never email or password).

nick.description: Public display name, nickname, or handle of the registered user.

verified.description: Indicates the community registration entry is verified.

PresenceSession.title: PresenceSession
PresenceSession.description: Ephemeral active visitor heartbeat document used to compute the real-time Online Agora counter.

active.description: Whether the browser tab session is currently active.

lastSeen.description: Server-validated timestamp of the latest heartbeat.

/community_members/{memberId}.description: Public list of registered community members (public nick and timestamp only).

/presence/{sessionId}.description: Active visitor sessions for real-time online presence tracking.
